verdict.rationale: An online IP-office portal could plausibly offer bulk actions, such as batch renewals, batch annuity payments, or mass updates of representative data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any operation applied across many items at once. The cited services (filings, partial renewals, divisions, updating representative data) are all described as single-application or single-right procedures, and the probe shows no agent-oriented documentation at all.
